build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45) + this folder's Improved Envelopes 0.1.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version EN02

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f; no card (starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M; DTBOOT_TURN_PNG after each turn

conditions: Cold boot; eight NO presses from 7003M, 300M apart, close the calibration notices. AMP at 11003M (12M). 64 turns of DEC (encoder 2) by -6, 20M apart from 11303M; then 6 turns of HLD (encoder 1) by +6, 20M apart from 12803M. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
